spans.s:
AMELIORATE, AMELIORATION: v. To improve,
improvement.

AMEN: ओ
or
आभ्। In non-ecclesiastical sense:
तथास्तु; एवमस्तु।

AMENABLE:
I Submissive, compliant: q. v.:
अनुविधायिन् (f. नी).
II Accountable to: Ph.
a. to our government
*अस्माकं शासनायत्ताः।

AMEND (v. i.): शुध्यति (शुध् c. 4): v. To mend,
improve.

AMEND (v. t.): शोधयति (c. of शुध्): v. To
correct, improve.

AMENDMENT:
I Correction, improvement:
q. v.: शोधनम्।
II A secondary resolution in
a bill or motion: *शोधनम्।

AMENDS: v. Compensation, satisfaction. To
make a.; v. To recompense, atone for

AMERCE: दण्डयति (दण्ड्, c. 10) (with double
acc.): v. To fine.
